konu: Theme 1: Music — Expressing Opinions, Music Preferences & Survey Report (E12.1.R2-E12.1.W1)
ciktilar: E12.1.R2. Students will be able to infer people's music preferences from their ideas about music in a reading text.
E12.1.S1. Students will be able to agree or disagree with others by sharing their opinions about music.
E12.1.L2. Students will be able to extract specific information from an announcement/advertisement about a music festival.
E12.1.W1. Students will be able to write a survey report on their friends' music preferences using quantifiers and percentages.
hatirla: To express opinions: 'In my opinion, ...', 'From my point of view, ...', 'Personally, I believe that ...'.
To agree: 'I completely agree with you.', 'That is exactly how I feel.'; To disagree: 'I am afraid I disagree.', 'I see your point, but ...'.
Survey report quantifiers: 'The vast majority of students (75%) ...', 'A small minority (15%) ...', 'Nearly half of the respondents ...'.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki müzik türü terimlerini sağdaki İngilizce açıklamalarıyla eşleştiriniz.
ciftler: Music produced solely by wooden instruments without electrical amplification
A formal text summarizing data, percentages and opinions from respondents
A pleasing and memorable tune that is easily remembered and sung
Expressing an opposing point of view in a respectful and gentle manner

sorular.soru: Görseldeki okul müzik anketi grafiği incelendiğinde, öğrencilerin çoğunluğunun müzik tercihini ifade eden doğru yargı aşağıdakilerden hangisidir?
secenekler: High school survey data indicates that modern upbeat tracks attract the highest student interest.
Classical music is the most popular music genre among high school students.
None of the respondents showed any interest in modern energetic rhythms.
Students completely dislike attending live acoustic open-air concerts.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki fikre katılma ifadesinde boş bırakılan kelimeyi yazınız: 'I completely ______ with your opinion.'
Görseldeki fikir belirtme ve müzik anketi kurallarına göre yargılardan doğru olanlara D, yanlış olanlara Y işaretleyiniz.

ifadeler.metin: 'In my opinion' and 'From my perspective' are used to express personal viewpoints.
'I am afraid I disagree' is an informal and rude way to reject an idea.
Wh- questions in English usually end with a falling intonation pattern.
Quantifiers like 'the majority of' cannot be combined with percentage data.

sorular.soru: Verilen ifadeleri 'Agreeing' (Katılma) ve 'Disagreeing' (Katılmama) kategorilerine göre tabloda işaretleyiniz.
satir_basliklari: I see eye to eye with you on this track
I am of a different opinion regarding his latest album
That is exactly what I was thinking about the concert
I see what you mean, but the rhythm is too fast

sorular.soru: Görseldeki bir anket raporu (survey report) yazım sürecinin adımlarını mantıksal olarak 1'den 4'e kadar sıralayınız.
ogeler: Designing clear survey questions about music preferences
Collecting responses and calculating numerical percentages
Analyzing key trends, majorities, and minority opinions
Writing the final conclusion and personal recommendations

sorular.soru: Görseldeki konuşma balonunda Mark: 'Heavy metal music is too loud and exhausting.' demiştir. Lisa'nın ona {koyu:kibarca karşı}
secenekler: I see your point, but guitar solos require great artistic talent.
I totally agree with you because loud sounds give me a headache.
You are definitely right and I will never listen to rock again.
That is so true since quiet acoustic songs are always superior.

sorular.soru: Bir ankette katılımcıların %75'ini ifade eden İngilizce nicelik belirtecini yazınız.
sorular.cevap: The vast majority (veya three quarters) ifadesidir.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki cümle yapılarını uygun tonlama (intonation) kurallarıyla eşleştiriniz.
ciftler: Rising intonation at the end of Yes/No question
What kind of music do you like?
Falling intonation at the end of Wh- question
I like pop, rock, and jazz.
Rising intonation on list items and falling on the last
Would you like to come with us?

sorular.soru: Müzik tercihleri ve anket raporu diline dair yargılardan doğru olanlara D, yanlış olanlara Y işaretleyiniz.

ifadeler.metin: A survey report should include both objective numbers and balanced summaries.
'A small minority' usually refers to more than eighty percent of a group.
Using linking words like 'however' and 'furthermore' enhances formal reports.
Expressing disagreement politely is an essential communicative social skill.

sorular.soru: Görseldeki müzik ipuçlarından yararlanarak bulmacayı çözünüz. Turuncu anahtar kutulardaki harflerle şifrelenmiş ritmik müzik terimini bulunuz.

satirlar.ipucu: Popular rhythmic rhyming urban music style
Pleasing combination of different musical notes
Pace and speed of a musical composition
Widely popular and successful chart song
Linear sequence of notes forming a tune

sorular.soru: Why is it important to use polite phrases when disagreeing with someone's music preference?
sorular.cevap: Musical tastes are subjective; polite phrases show.
